meta.title: Integrations: n8n, Slack, Discord, Telegram, MCP and SMTP
meta.description: Connect MepMail to n8n, Slack, Discord, Telegram, MCP and SMTP: notifications, inboxes for AI agents and a Resend-compatible API.

hero.title: Your stack stays. <highlight>Your email lives in one place.</highlight>
hero.lead: Connect workflows, team chat, AI agents and apps to MepMail. The same verified domains, dashboard and logs, with the right credential for each job.
hero.note: Every integration says which credential it uses. A key only reaches what it needs: a Send key cannot read mailboxes, and a mailbox key cannot send broadcasts.

items.name: n8n
items.body: Send email and manage contacts, broadcasts, domains and suppressions inside your workflows. Or start a workflow when something happens to your email.
bullets: Send, schedule, cancel and batch send straight from a workflow node.
The MepMail Trigger subscribes to the events you pick and registers (and removes) its own webhook automatically.
Mail: start a workflow when email reaches an agent mailbox, read the message and save a reply draft.
Payload signatures (Svix / Standard Webhooks) verified out of the box.

items.name: Slack · Discord · Telegram
items.body: Point a webhook at your channel. MepMail uses the service's native format, without middleware or a relay service.
bullets: Paste the incoming-webhook URL: Slack, Discord and Telegram are detected and formatted natively (Telegram takes the sendMessage URL with your chat id).
Deliveries, bounces, complaints and deliverability alerts land where the team already is.
Every other endpoint keeps the raw signed JSON. The same webhooks, with nothing extra to configure.

items.name: AI agents
items.body: Claude, Cursor, VS Code and any Model Context Protocol client send email and manage the account through the MCP tools, on the same pipeline as the REST API.
bullets: Verified domains, suppressions, topic opt-outs, quotas and team scope all apply.
With a Send key, the MCP creates mailboxes and agent keys without reading messages. Connected by OAuth with the mail permissions, it also reads and drafts in the mailboxes you tick.

items.name: Mail for agents
items.body: Give the agent its own mailbox on your domain. Through the Mail MCP it lists and reads messages, saves drafts and replies, no code.
bullets: The agent lists and reads messages, saves drafts and replies in the conversation itself, without code.
One key per mailbox (mmb_) or one for several of your mailboxes (mmt_). Revoke it any time in Mail.
Each key's last use and last send show in Mail, and the mailbox history shows every agent action.

credentials.title: Which credential to use
credentials.lead: There are three kinds, each with the least reach its job needs.

items.name: Send key (ms_)
items.body: REST API, SMTP relay, Resend SDKs, CLI, the local MCP and the n8n node. Full access or sending only, and optionally limited to one domain. It cannot read or write Mail mailboxes.

items.name: Mailbox key (mmb_ or mmt_)
items.body: The agent works in one mailbox (mmb_) or several of yours (mmt_), through the Mail MCP, the Mail API or n8n. Each key picks read, draft and send; without send, the draft waits for your approval.

items.name: OAuth
items.body: The hosted MCP (Claude, ChatGPT and other clients) asks for permissions on a consent screen, with no key to paste. With the mail permissions it reads and drafts only in the mailboxes you tick.
